create_team: create a new LiteLLM proxy team with budget limits, models, and team members
update_team: update an existing LiteLLM proxy team's budget, models, rate limits, or organization membership
delete_team: delete one or more LiteLLM proxy teams along with their associated keys and memberships
add_team_member: add one or more users to a LiteLLM proxy team with optional budget and role settings
list_teams: list LiteLLM proxy teams with pagination, filtering by user, organization, or status
